expectations.text: Flags the GET handler in routes.ts for querying the database directly instead of delegating to the service layer
expectations.evidence: A-1 `routes.ts:3, 7, 29–47` — 'роут ходить у БД повз сервіс'; names the `routes-through-service` rule, notes `exports` is not in LAYERLESS_MODULES, and gives the fix: add `listForPull` to ExportsService and reduce the handler to `return service.listForPull(workspaceId, req.params.id)`.

expectations.text: Flags the service for constructing OctokitGitHubClient itself, and says the adapter must be resolved through the container
expectations.evidence: A-2 `service.ts:5, 40–43` — quotes `new OctokitGitHubClient(token)`, cites `no-direct-adapter-clients`, and prescribes `const github = await this.container.github();`, plus notes the three lines duplicate `Container.github()` including its cache invalidation.

expectations.text: Flags the service for taking FastifyRequest (reading headers/body) instead of receiving resolved values such as workspaceId and the parsed body
expectations.evidence: A-3 `service.ts:1, 25–27` — '`FastifyRequest` протік у сервіс'; cites `service-stays-http-agnostic`, correctly notes this rule has no `dependencyTypesNot: ['type-only']` escape so even `import type` errors, and gives the signature `create(workspaceId, prId, input)`. A-4 `service.ts:26` separately covers the raw `x-workspace-id` header read.

expectations.text: Every finding names a file and a line (or line range)
expectations.evidence: 15 of 18 findings carry file+line (A-1…A-5, B-1…B-6, C-1…C-4). The three without a line — B-7 (missing registration in `server/src/modules/index.ts`), C-5 (`service.ts`, missing `createdBy`), C-6 (no tests in the set) — are absence-of-code findings where no line can exist.

expectations.text: Does not claim repository.ts leaks across workspaces — every query in that file is already scoped by workspaceId
expectations.evidence: No such claim. The review states '`repository.ts` при цьому написаний майже правильно — його чіпати треба найменше'; its only repository.ts findings are C-1 (dead/unlimited `listForPull`), C-3 (`inserted!`) and C-4 (`row.format as ExportFormat`). The tenancy hole it reports (A-4) is the `x-workspace-id` header read in service.ts, which is correct.

expectations.text: The fixture files are byte-identical to before the run (the task was a review, not a fix)

notes: Found all three planted violations and named the exact depcruise rule behind each, including the subtle point that `service-stays-http-agnostic` has no type-only exemption so `import type { FastifyRequest }` alone is an error. Fix directions are concrete and repo-grounded (container.github(), service.listForPull delegation, ContainerOverrides for tests, *.it.test.ts glob). Most of its volume is the unavoidable does-not-compile noise (missing `exports` table, contracts, helpers/constants, `listReviews`, `repoFullName`, `commitUrl`), all of which checks out against the real repo.
